name: AesculaTech
long_description:
AesculaTech believes in building better lives through smart chemistry. We design custom smart materials for a range of biomedical, commercial, and industrial applications. Our platform technology, AesculaGel offers adaptive response to a wide range of stimuli and can be tailor-made for biocompatibility, material strength, and a range of other attributes. 

Founded by one of MIT's 35 under 35 Innovators, AesculaTech is the shared vision of scientists, engineers, and medical experts. Our cornerstone product, Humidifeye, is an ophthalmic platform to treat dry eye disease. Dry eye affects more than 25 million Americans and the global treatment market is projected higher than $6 Billion within the next decade. Our thermally responsive, form-fitting materials are suitable for sustained yet reversible occlusion across a range of treatment times. In contrast to existing technologies, our product will not extrude, or cause discomfort as it adapts to patients. Though Humidifeye is not yet FDA approved, expect to hear about it soon!

In coordination with partners across several sectors, we have a variety of groundbreaking technologies in the works that live up to our vision. This work has already been recognized. AesculaTech was named a Rosenman Innovator, received a National Science Foundation I-Corps grant, was a finalist in the 2019 Octane High Tech Awards, and is a graduate of both the Y Combinator and TMCx accelerator programs. In short, Y-Combinator was only the beginning.

I was included in MIT's 2018 35 Innovators Under 35. My company participated in YCombinator 2018.

launches.title: Pippa: a Pelvic Floor Fitness Booster for Women
launches.body:
# **Meet Pippa**

# The world's first workout product designed to boost pelvic floor fitness—just by wearing it while you move.

[https://youtu.be/OP0vhTb6n8U?si=ZOPh69qU3PaznicV](https://youtu.be/OP0vhTb6n8U?si=ZOPh69qU3PaznicV%5C)

Pippa is worn internally (like a tampon). The soft silicone spring gently conforms to the body, activating pelvic floor muscles with each step, stretch, or squat. No batteries, no routines—just natural, effortless, on-the-go exercise.

**✅**  Significantly increases neuromuscular activation\
✅  Fits seamlessly into a daily workout or walk\
✅  Two models for a comfy, personalized fit

**The Problem**

78M American women worry about pelvic floor weakness, including college and pro athletes, new moms, and older women. Pelvic floor weakness can lead to a range of problems, including urinary and fecal incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, and more, significantly impacting quality of life. Most solutions are high-effort, expensive, inconvenient — or all of the above.

# **The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/4f74514a-9282-4194-b496-f5a8f8bb9a9e)

Pippa is the world’s first _conforming resistance spring._ It comes in two sizes and levels of resistance: light (42mm) and medium (50mm).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/b5b7eaf1-5356-4c53-a2f9-deb7d4cb441e)

It works like a resistance band, but for hard-to-reach inner core.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/0d8c4d39-8f5e-41f3-ad68-1bd2736df857)

Pippa passively responds to core muscle movement by expanding and compressing, thereby activating the muscles and increasing effective function by up to 35%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/483ecf52-ea8b-4f74-9b7f-11f453d8460e)

The reusable applicator makes it easy to put Pippa into place. The large finger loop makes anytime removal a breeze.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91753&key=user_uploads/583225/c47281f3-861d-4a89-baef-c1226c1e9092)

# **The Founders**

Product inventor, [Carly Price](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pricecarly/) (L), has designed many award-winning and commercially successful consumer products. She conceived Pippa after trying different solutions for kegel exercise and bladder support, none of which met her comfort and convenience expectations. \
\
Cofounder and CEO, [Melody Roberts](https://www.linkedin.com/in/melodyannroberts/) (R), incubated service models and self-ordering solutions for McDonald’s and Panera. \
\
We worked with a wide range of experts–including urogynecologists, physiotherapists, and other health professionals–to ensure Pippa would be comfortable and fully safe.

# **Our Asks**

* **Get the full story** at [**Kickstarter**](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/liv-labs/get-fit-inside-and-out-with-pippa)
* **Share this post** **with friends and family** of any age
* **Suggest potential retailers** to [**melody@livlabsfitness.com**](mailto:melody@liv-labs.com)

name: Scout
long_description:
Digital health holds a lot of potential but is ignoring a growing problem: diagnostic testing. Without this data, providers and organizations will be limited in the services they can provide patients at home.

Scout has developed a platform - Hub, test kits, and app - that delivers health testing at home with 10x lower development cost and 3x lower per-test price. Our patented tech also meets performance requirements for medical diagnoses and integrates with the current healthcare tech stack. Scout’s technology is poised to disrupt the outdated $33Bn diagnostic market by democratizing testing while dramatically improving the patient experience.

Scout has received $16M in non-dilutive funding from the NIH and other organizations to fully de-risk our platform, and our pipeline includes a diverse test menu for primary care (e.g. respiratory and sexual health), wellness (e.g. gut health), and chronic conditions (e.g. certain cancers). We have already received FDA authorization for our platform in clinical settings and are planning to launch our flagship Scout Hub in 2024.
one_liner: The smart testing platform that unlocks digital health at home.

launches.tagline: Adding meat back into plant-based meat to make protein meat eaters want.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

_At_ [_Momentum Foods_](https://www.linkedin.com/company/momentumfoods/)_, we’re adding meat back into plant-based meat to make it more affordable, healthy, and delicious._ 

### **Overview**

After five years developing and scaling textured protein (the base of every product) at Beyond Meat, I realized two things:

1. Plant-based meat companies don’t have a clear path to improving product quality _and_ decreasing cost.
2. The 96% of the population that regularly eats meat cares more about cost, health, and flavor than whether their food is vegan.

By combining plant protein with the best parts of meat, we can finally make a product that’s less expensive than the real thing, but nearly indistinguishable from it — all while being better for the planet.

### **Our Retail Brand, Paul’s Table:**

[Paul’s Table](https://www.paulstable.com/) delivers our vision of competitive price, flavor, and health. Everyday products for everyday people. Coming to stores in Summer 2023.

launches.title: Dex – Your AI Coworker for the Browser
launches.tagline: Turn your browser into a smart interface that works alongside you.
launches.body:
Hey! We’re Kevin and Regina from [Dexterity](https://getdexterity.com/). Today, we’re launching Dex—the fastest interface for co-working with AI, right inside your browser.

**TLDR:** **AI that works _with you,_ not just for you**. 10x your workflows without breaking your flow. Try [**Dex**](https://youtu.be/H6hMAVkGp8M) (Beta) → [**getdexterity.com**](http://getdexterity.com)

### **Why We’re Building This**

**Four weeks before Demo Day, we pivoted to build for ourselves.**

Most AI web agents today are “set-and-forget” chats—you hand them off and check back later. But what about workflows you actually _want_ to drive? Navigating platforms, moving data, making quick decisions—these moments demand instant, context-aware models that work with you, not just for you.

Imagine using Operator to order DoorDash—a frustratingly back-and-forth relay with no real-time visibility. That same friction exists for work tools like Jira, GSuite, and GitHub, where users need instant feedback and responsive action, not slow AI handoffs.

**That’s why we’re taking a Cursor (vs. Devin) approach—for the browser.**

### **The Problem**

Modern work is a juggling act of 15+ tabs, software bloat, and constant UI friction, just to complete a single task.

The real bottleneck isn’t just automation—it’s context switching. Traditional solutions force users to memorize shortcuts (appeals to devs, but leaves everyone else behind), while AI tools make you adapt to them instead of living right where you work.

**Why not turn your browser itself into an intelligent personal workspace?**

### **How It Works**

With simple voice and text, Dex enhances familiar interfaces, automates mundane actions, and understands your intent.

* **Smart Navigation**🔸Find, execute, and move between apps.
* **Suggest Context**🔸Cut down tab-switching and manual searching.
* **Cross-App Automation**🔸Shortcut multi-step workflows, zero setup.
* **Adaptive UI/UX**🔸Reshape, replicate, and browse by your rules.

Think of it like Spotlight Search meets AI automation + personal expert for everyday apps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87902&key=user_uploads/1003357/5841f4c8-281d-4bdd-a4b0-053d44c7b41d)

### **Use Cases**

* **GSuite** – Write emails, find docs, and move data anywhere.
* **GitHub** – Search repos, manage issues, and navigate faster.
* **Omni AI** – Talk to and reference live tabs or integrated apps.

### **Coming Soon…**

* **Meetings** 📅 → Create and join calendar and Zoom events instantly
* **Sales** 💼 → Automate clicks across LinkedIn, Sheets, and Apollo.io
* **Snippets** ✂️ → Dex captures notes, links, and frequent snippets
* **Food** 🍔 → Speak to browse options and order DoorDash

### **Our Ask**

We’re building Dex for power users, founders, students, and curious explorers—because that’s who we are.

[**Join our waitlist**](https://getdexterity.com/) → **Get notified when Dex goes live on the Chrome store**.\
[**Follow us on Twitter**](https://x.com/dexterity_ai) → Stay updated on latest features.\
[**Discord**](https://x.com/dexterity_ai) → Get to know us more personally + brainstorm cool ideas.

Drop dream features to [regina@getdexterity.com](mailto:regina@getdexterity.com) and let us know what you think!

launches.title: Stratify - The AI User Researcher
launches.tagline: The AI-powered user research platform that discovers the why behind every customer decision, behavior, and preference.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Siddhartha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) and [Pratham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal/), co-founders of [Stratify](https://www.trystratify.com) and we’re saving companies millions by helping them understand their users better.

# **TL;DR**

Failing to understand _what_ your users truly want can kill a company. Stratify uses AI agentic workflows to instantly recruit participants, conduct dynamic user interviews, analyze responses, and provide actionable feedback. With simple queries like "What do users think of our new checkout flow?" or “Which prototype resonates most with users?”, Stratify delivers authentic customer feedback within a few hours.

[Stratify Launch Video](https://youtu.be/j0Py7pKyuy4)

---

# **🤦‍♂️ The User Research Problem**

**Here's the brutal truth**: 90% of product failures happen because teams don't truly understand their users. You can’t really blame them because traditional user research **is broken**:

1. **💸 Focus groups are expensive:** $15K+ for 8 people in a room for 2 hours. Half of them drop out last minute, and you're left wondering if these insights represent your actual users.
2. **📅 Manual interviews take weeks:** Booking user interviews feels like herding cats. Calendars stay empty for weeks while your launch deadline approaches. And big ideas _cannot_ wait.
3. **📝 Surveys are unresponsive and impersonal:** Generic forms with dropdown menus can't capture the _why_ behind user behavior. You get some data, but absolutely no story.

**The result?** Teams ship based on assumptions, not insights. Features flop. Users churn. Millions of dollars wasted.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90668&key=user_uploads/2549216/0e975083-d540-4aed-91ac-ea337164777b)

---

# **✨ Introducing Stratify**

What if you could ask "What do users think of our new product?" and get answers from hundreds of real users in under a few hours? That's exactly what Stratify does.

1. **🚀 Define your Research Questions:**

   Simply describe what you want to learn about your product or upload product materials: _"How do millennials feel about our pricing?"_ Our vetted AI researcher transforms your query into a comprehensive study framework in seconds.
2. **🎯 Smart Participant Matching:**

   Set demographic and behavioral parameters or simply specify a query like "U.S., Gen Z, Online Shopper, Foodie". Our AI automatically finds the perfect participants from our network of millions of real users or directly within your own company’s customers.
3. **🎥 Uncover Real Insights:**

   Watch our AI agents conduct hundreds of interviews simultaneously, asking follow-up questions that dynamically adapt to each participant’s unique responses. Uncover the _why_ behind user behaviors that surveys and focus groups miss completely.
4. **🧠 Instant Analysis:**

   Transform hours of interview content into actionable intelligence instantly. Search conversations semantically, generate reports and slides presentations, or simply chat with your data to find exactly what you need to know.

---

---

# **🎉 Our Ask**

* **🚀 Building something new?** Try Stratify before your next feature launch, whether that’s your website, onboarding flow, product prototypes, etc. It could save you months of building the wrong thing—seriously.
* **💬 Know any product managers, product designers, or founders?** They'd love this. User research is their biggest pain point.
* **🙌 Support us** with a follow or share. Every bit helps us reach more teams who are tired of guessing what users want.

---

# **👥 The Team**

[**Siddhartha**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) (CEO) and [**Pratham**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal) (CTO) have studied computer science at Stanford, where they’ve conducted AI and high performance compute research at renowned labs. They met in their freshman dorm at Stanford and have been roommates and building together since.

They’ve been in your shoes. They’ve launched features that flopped, ignored user feedback until it was too late, and learned the hard way that assumptions kill products. Now they’re making sure no other team has to learn it the hard way.

---

---

---

---

**_Users have opinions. Are you listening?_**

* **Try Stratify:** [https://www.trystratify.com](https://www.trystratify.com/%5C)
* **Questions?:** [sid@trystratify.com](mailto:sid@trystratify.com) & [pratham@trystratify.com](mailto:pratham@trystratify.com)

name: Egoist Machines
long_description:
Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose.

AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data.

Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access.

We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers.

The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use.

Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.
one_liner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.

launches.title: Egoist Machines: user-owned hyper-personalisation infrastructure for Web 4.0
launches.tagline: One portable, permissioned memory and context layer for hyper-personalisation across every AI application.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We are building AI Passport, the user-owned context layer for consumer AI. It lets people carry their personal context between products while controlling exactly what each product can access, why, and for how long.

Read our manifesto for the bigger vision: <https://ego.ist/notes/the-egoist-machine>

Create your AI Passport to start taking control of your data: <https://ego.ist/>

**Ask**: if you’re working on a consumer-facing AI application, or know someone who is, we’d love to chat: [founders@ego.ist](mailto:founders@ego.ist)

<https://youtu.be/nLnZNjyHV0s>

The next era of consumer technology will be **hyper-personalised**. The products that understand each user from the very first interaction will create fundamentally better experiences and, we believe, the next consumer decacorns. People increasingly lack the time and patience to train every new product from scratch.

The main blocker to ubiquitous consumer AI is that every major AI assistant and consumer app is building its own private and incomplete model of the same person. ChatGPT holds one model, Claude another, while the data in health apps, calendar, shopping history, travel accounts, wearables, and financial tools remain trapped in separate silos. No product has the complete context needed to understand you, and no user has a single place from which to control it.

As a result:

\- Users get bored of repeatedly explaining themselves;

\- Companies spend money building context that already exists;

\- Personal data remains trapped inside platforms the user does not control.

The natural end state of this inefficiency is one user-owned memory and context layer that sits above individual products. Apps request the specific context they need, and users grant scoped, time-limited access instead of permanently surrendering their data.

**_That is AI Passport_**.

---

## How AI Passport works

AI Passport is a centralised, user-controlled home for personal context.

You can think of it as **Link for personal context**. Link lets people securely save their payment and shipping information once and reuse it across businesses; AI Passport does the same for _all_ your context, including preferences, interests, goals, history, health, travel, and so much more.

Users bring this context into one centralised AI Passport by connecting the apps and AI assistants they already use. They can also save anything they discover online or on social media directly to their Passport. New information enters an approval inbox, where the user decides whether it becomes _private memory_ or part of their _living, shareable public profile_.

That same Passport then becomes a plug-and-play connector for consumer apps through our **Sign in with AI Passport** OAuth system:

1\. An app requests the specific context it needs.

2\. The user sees exactly what is being requested, why it is needed, and how long access will last.

3\. The user can approve, edit, or deny the request, with the option to grant one-time, time-limited, or continuing access .

4\. Every permission can later be inspected or revoked.

We are launching AI Passport directly to consumers and through distribution and deep-integration partners collectively reaching millions of users across dining, ride-hailing, wearables, healthcare, lifestyle, finance and more.

We built a custom memory backend for AI Passport. It is optimised for compact, exact retrieval across isolated per-user memory stores and supports cryptographic access control at the memory layer. The retrieval path is constrained by the user's active permission, so the product can access only the context authorised for that purpose and period.

---

## Who we are

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111045&key=user_uploads/3328552/4bb1bba6-8c9f-4d94-b88a-28051f5e6e45)

**Dr David Khachaturov** holds a PhD (Uni of Cambridge) in Computer Science and is the youngest-ever Fellow at St Catharine's College, Cambridge. Previously an ML Researcher at OpenAI (PaperBench) and Lead AI Security Researcher at FrontierOne.

**Erin Meryl McGurk** grew 0 to 1M followers on socials in one year. Advised Uni of Cambridge, UK Govt, OpenAI on social media strategy. Founded social enterprise Girl Economics to 15 countries, 75 ambassadors, 10+ weekly events.

---

## Our Ask

**For users:** create your AI Passport (<https://ego.ist>) and tell us what you think!

**For builders:** if you are building a product that could benefit from richer user context, explore our developer docs (<https://ego.ist/docs>) and feel free to reach out to [founders@ego.ist](mailto:founders@ego.ist).

We would especially value introductions to teams building consumer AI, wearables, health products, commerce experiences, or agents that need bounded access to sensitive personal information. If that is you, I want to chat: <https://calendar.app.google/qT5ccAUEqB9V82Uz9>
